_comment: §4.7.1. Six patterns that pair precedent_search with a correctness question — which props are legal, which version, which enum domain. Those need an EXACT answer from the registry, never a nearest-neighbour from retrieval; a skill doc that routes such a question to precedent_search reintroduces the ambiguity the registry removes. g-rag-isolation fails on any plugins/**/*.md matching any of these.
patterns: precedent_search[\s\S]{0,120}(enum domain|allowed values|reference list values|which enum)
